newsitem.title: UK: UK shares edge higher, cautious ahead of UK data.
newsitem.headline: UK shares edge higher, cautious ahead of UK data.

text.p: British shares started mixed on Wednesday in cautious trading ahead of a raft of domestic economic data due at 0930 GMT, dealers said.

But yet another record high on the Dow, the fifth in succession, was shrugged off as was the long anticipated emergence of a 1.3 billion stg agreed bid for East Midlands Electricity from Dominion Resources of the U.S.
While East Midlands shares rose on news of the offer, the bid failed to fire the rest of the market, the FTSE 100 edging just 4.9 points higher to 3,939.2 shortly after the start of trading.
